recommendation: Keep this source fix and add or preserve generation-time checks so future CodeSystem.valueSet targets are emitted with immutable=true. Do not broaden the rule to unrelated all-code ValueSets unless a separate work-group decision says so.
issue_request: FHIR-11910 asked whether a ValueSet whose CLD is all codes in a code system should be immutable. The Published/Persuasive resolution narrowed the rule to ValueSets referred to from CodeSystem.valueSet: they SHALL be immutable and SHALL only reference that code system; other ValueSets are author discretion.
initial_application: The issue was originally recorded as applied in SVN revision 10165, and the current CodeSystem.valueSet comment already carries the SHALL immutable/all-and-only-codes rule. FHIR-15587 later explicitly added that wording in SVN revisions 13127/13130, and git commit 27b184d047 refined it for FHIR-36837 without removing the immutable requirement.
additional_context: The Zulip Task 11910 discussion confirms the scope is the CodeSystem.valueSet nominated all-code ValueSet, not every all-code CLD. Current build spot checks showed active pairs such as task-business-status and resource-status had CodeSystem.valueSet populated while the referenced ValueSet had immutable false or absent. fhir.ini identifies the edited resource folders as active resources and fivews as an active logical source; disabled/archive/out-of-build cases were not edited.
reconciliation: Changed 62 active local all-code ValueSet XML sources to include immutable=true, either by adding the missing element before compose or by changing existing immutable=false to true.
